title: GOAL: full-Claude orchestrator: Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 executors, Codex kept but off; reliable efficient Claude workers; subagents; wide parallel across three repos without cross-talk
spec:
Human request 2026-09-30 (orchestrator session): make the orchestrator a full Claude workflow. Filed as a goal for later; nothing is started. Planner starts it after luna-inbox goal T-0551 lands.

W1 Claude-only executors, Codex kept but off
- Executors become claude:opus (claude-opus-5-5) and a new claude:sonnet (claude-sonnet-5-5) row; routing picks sonnet for c1-5 and opus for c6-10 by default, scorecard evidence may move the line.
- Every codex row (astra, luna, terra, sol, *6) stays in pool.toml with enabled = false. The human is cancelling the Codex subscription; the code path stays so re-subscribing is a config flip.
- Remove every hard Codex assumption: codex_available gates, [codex] on_exhausted = fallback_claude becomes the normal path, codex/codex_reply MCP tools, fix rounds that resume a Codex thread (Claude fix rounds need their own resume or fresh-context path), scorecard and allocation priors keyed on Codex ids, review_rule "other model" (Claude-executed work needs a cross-tier rule: sonnet work reviewed by opus and vice versa).
- Account capacity: two Claude accounts now carry execution, review and Planner. Budgets, window caps, max_parallel_claude_workers (4 today) and the planner reserve need re-sizing.
- Interim note: while Codex rows are enabled and the subscription lapses, dispatch to Codex fails. Disabling the codex rows in each repo's pool.toml is the first, config-only step.

W2 Claude executors efficient and error-free (known defects from plan.md backlog)
- run_worker marks correct work failed/non_json when the final message is prose (luna T-0514, T-0526): derive the result from git state (commits on the task branch, clean tree).
- Workers background the gate or hit the 10-minute shell cap and exit without committing (luna T-0282, T-0425): execute prompt says commit first, run focused tests in the foreground, never background; the daemon gates externally; run_worker commits leftover changes or resumes once with "commit now".
- A failed (not held) execute task gets no fix round (luna T-0465): treat it like held.
- Efficiency: packet size, turn caps, prompt caching, model choice per task class, measured tokens per accepted task against a baseline taken before the switch.

W3 Subagents
- An execute worker may fan out subagents (Claude Code Agent tool) for independent parts of its task: same worktree or child worktrees, a shared budget, scope enforced for every subagent write, usage attributed to the parent task in run rows and the scorecard.
- The Planner may use subagents for scouting instead of spawn_scout where cheaper; decide by measurement.

W4 Wide parallel across three repos (tens of workers at once), no cross-talk
- Today each repo has its own bus and daemon (ORCH_ROOT), but accounts, the Claude worker cap, Planner usage tallies, notify, the Xcode/simulator gate and local ports (Supabase, Postgres) are shared machine resources.
- Needs: a machine-wide scheduler or lease layer for accounts and worker slots across repos; per-repo namespaces for locks, ports and simulator devices; disk-space floor before dispatch (the ENOSPC incident); worktree cleanup after merge (backlog HIGH); daemon restart that re-adopts in-flight workers (backlog HIGH).
- Evidence: a soak run with three repos and tens of concurrent workers, report of collisions, queue waits and cost.

Related backlog already in .orchestrator/plan.md: Claude result parsing, commit-first, failed-task fix rounds, worktree cleanup, orphaned workers on daemon restart, failure_kind quota misclassification, goal start staging pool.toml.
acceptance: Planner closes the goal with a PR goal/<id> -> main after every workstream below is merged and the gate is green

W1: with every codex row disabled, a goal in this repo runs end to end (dispatch, gate, review, merge) on claude:opus and claude:sonnet rows only; re-enabling a codex row needs one pool.toml flag and no code change

W2: over one real goal, zero Claude execute tasks end failed/non_json or with uncommitted work when the worktree held a correct change; median tokens per accepted Claude task recorded against the baseline
W3: an execute task can declare subagents and the worker runs them inside its own worktree and budget, with their usage attributed to the task
W4: three repos run goals at the same time with tens of workers in flight and no shared-state collision (bus, locks, worktrees, ports, simulators, accounts), shown by a soak run and its report

constraints.status_note: filed only; not started. Start after goal T-0551 in luna-inbox lands.
